title: State of AI in 2026: LLMs, Coding, Scaling Laws, China, Agents, GPUs, AGI
description: Lex Fridman Podcast #490 with Nathan Lambert & Sebastian Raschka covering LLMs and AI coding capabilities, scaling laws, AI agents, GPU infrastructure, AGI development, and China vs US AI competition.
author: Lex Fridman Podcast

title: AI coding tools are shifting to a surprising place: The terminal
description: TechCrunch article discussing how AI coding tools are shifting from IDE-based editors to terminal-based workflows, marking a significant evolution in developer tooling.
author: TechCrunch

title: Claws - a new layer on top of LLM agents
description: Posted about 'Claws' as 'a new layer on top of LLM agents,' giving an example of how '/add-telegram instructs your AI agent how to modify the actual code to integrate Telegram'.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: LLMs are especially good at code translation
description: Karpathy discussed how 'LLMs are *especially* good at translation compared to de-novo generation because the original code base acts as a kind of [reference/context]'.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Imagination is the only limit - AI coding agents demo
description: Amjad challenges the notion that AI coding agents can only build basic, cookie-cutter apps, stating he proved this wrong with a major public demo showing advanced capabilities.
author: Amjad Masad

title: In the AI age, coding capabilities belong to everyone
description: He emphasizes that in the AI age, coding capabilities belong to everyone, especially entrepreneurs. Mentions the rise of agentic coding tools like Replit has caused changes in development costs.
author: Amjad Masad

title: How I write software with LLMs
description: Hacker News discussion featuring first-hand developer experience using LLMs for software development with practical insights on integrating LLMs into coding workflows.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Shift in LLM coding capability - from 80% manual to more agent usage
description: Karpathy shared notes about 'coding quite a bit' and mentioned the 'latest lift in LLM coding capability,' noting he shifted from '80% manual+autocomplete coding and 20% agents'.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Vibe coding tools capability shift
description: Amjad discusses 'vibe coding tools' that enable marketers and small business owners to describe applications in plain English and have them running in minutes, describing this as a significant capability shift.
author: Amjad Masad

title: Hacker News now thinks coding is solved
description: Reddit discussion debating whether coding is truly being 'solved' by AI and questioning if Hacker News has become overly optimistic about AI capabilities.
author: Reddit Community

title: I've never felt this much behind as a programmer
description: Notable tweet where Karpathy stated: 'I've never felt this much behind as a programmer. The profession is being dramatically refactored as the bits...'
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Coding agents have replaced every framework I used
description: Hacker News discussion about AI coding agents replacing traditional development frameworks and exploring implications of AI-assisted development workflows.
author: Hacker News Community

title: Claude Code / AI that lives on your computer
description: Karpathy discussed Claude Code as 'the first convincing demonstration of what an LLM Agent looks like' - highlighting it as a significant milestone in AI agent development.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: How to make vibe coding not suck
description: Fireship critique of AI 'vibe coding' practices with best practices for AI-assisted development and modern programming workflows.
author: Fireship

title: AI doesn't reduce work, it intensifies it
description: Hacker News discussion challenging the narrative that AI reduces developer workload, exploring how AI tools require programming skills to be effective.
author: Hacker News Community

title: OpenAI just made your entire tech stack obsolete
description: Fireship video covering the Junie coding agent for JetBrains IDE and discussing OpenAI DevDay 2025 announcements about AI coding tools.
author: Fireship

title: My Bleeding Edge Tech Stack for 2025
description: Fireship AI-driven development masterclass covering modern programming workflows and the bleeding edge tech stack for 2025.
author: Fireship

title: Here's how I use LLMs to help me write code
description: Discusses the challenges and unintuitive nature of using LLMs for coding. Explores how to effectively leverage LLMs as complementary tools rather than replacements. Simon emphasizes practical LLM integration in developer workflows.
author: Simon Willison

title: Enhancing LLM Code Generation through Test-Driven Development
description: ArXiv paper on improving LLM code generation capabilities using TDD methodologies, reflecting growing emphasis on practical improvement techniques for code LLMs.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: Increasing LLM Coding Capabilities through Diverse Synthetic Data
description: ArXiv paper tackling the limitation of progress in code generation due to data shortages by using diverse synthetic data to boost model performance.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: Multicalibration for LLM-based Code Generation
description: Studies four multicalibration approaches on function synthesis benchmarks using latest-generation code LLMs including Qwen3 Coder and GPT-OSS.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: CWM: An Open-Weights LLM for Research on Code Generation with World Models
description: Meta's release of a 32-billion-parameter open-weights LLM for agentic coding and Python code execution simulation, cited by 17 papers.
author: J. Copet et al.

title: A quarter of startups in YC's current cohort have AI-generated codebases
description: TechCrunch reports that a quarter of the W25 startup batch have 95% of their codebases almost entirely AI-generated, highlighting the rapid adoption of AI coding tools in startups.
author: TechCrunch

title: Enhancing LLM Code Generation: Systematic Evaluation
description: ArXiv paper addressing the emergence of automated code generation as a major AI research focus, presenting multi-faceted evaluation approaches for LLM-based code generation.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: Assessing LLM Code Generation Quality through Path Planning
description: ArXiv paper with critical finding that LLM-generated code presents serious hazards for path planning applications and should not be applied in safety-critical contexts without thorough evaluation.
author: ArXiv Researchers

title: Paper2Code: Automating Code Generation from Scientific Papers
description: ArXiv paper (2504.17192) focusing on automating code generation from ML research papers, cited by 44 papers.
author: M. Seo et al.

title: A Survey on Code Generation with LLM-based Agents
description: Comprehensive survey on code generation agents powered by LLMs, discussing how these agents are revolutionizing software development by handling complex programming tasks that exceed individual LLM limitations.
author: Y. Dong et al.
